title: SE implementation scratchpad - Copper Bay Finance
content:
Meeting notes (02/27) - kickstart with CB team:
- Attendees: Jordan (SE), Maya (Infra), Rafael (Customer eng), Priya (CB Sec)
- Goal: get Private on-prem POC running with 1x A10G equivalent node, KMS integration, and model v1.2 pinned for initial tests.

High-level plan (today -> next 4 weeks):
1) Network & infra prep (TODO owner: Maya)
   - Confirm VPC connectivity: CB will provide CIDR + BGP details by 2026-03-03 (Rafael to send).
   - IP allowlist for control plane: add 52.14.33.0/24 and 34.210.0.0/16 (still waiting confirmation from net team).
   - On-prem firewall: need outbound to control.redwood.com:443 and aws-kms endpoints.
   - VPN vs direct peering: CB prefers VPN for POC; prepare VPN instructions (strongswan) and shared PSK.

2) Secrets & KMS (TODO owner: Jordan/Priya)
   - KMS: CB uses Azure Key Vault. Confirm RBAC + service principal scope.
   - Needed: 1 service principal with `wrapKey` permissions. Document minimal policy (TODO).
   - Local HSM option scoped for later; for now use KV + CMK wrapping.

3) Deployment config (TODO owner: Jordan)
   - Model: start with open-llama-7b-v1 (quantized int8) -> Redwood runtime profile: rwd-int8-lowmem.
   - GPU profile: 1xA10G equivalent, 32GB GPU memory. config snippet (for ops):
     - runtime.mode: private
     - model.path: /var/models/open-llama-7b-v1/quantized
     - pinned.version: v1.2
     - batch.max_tokens: 512
     - batching.strategy: latency-priority
   - KV cache: enable prefix caching for chat flows (expect 20% token savings).

4) Canary / rollout plan (TODO owner: Maya/Jordan)
   - Start: 100 rps synthetic with canary tag -> compare latency & 99p error to hosted baseline.
   - Canary window 30m, health checks: p50/p95/p99 latency, model-accuracy (smoke prompts).
   - Auto rollback threshold: +30% p99 vs baseline or >2% logical output regression on eval set.

5) Monitoring & alerts (owner: Rafael)
   - Need metrics wired to CB Datadog: token_rate, request_rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, gpu_util, kv_hit_rate, disk_io.
   - Alerting thresholds draft: p99 > 1.2s -> Sev2, gpu_util > 95% for 5m -> Sev2.

Quick config notes / commands:
- Install container (on node):
  curl -fsSL https://deploy.redwood.com/private/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- --role inference --env cb-poc
- Check runtime health: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://local-inference:8080/health
- Model load command: rwdctl models load --name open-llama-7b-v1 --quant int8 --pin v1.2

Open questions / blockers:
- CB security requires FIPS mode for KMS calls - need to confirm if our client supports FIPS TLS stack. (action: Jordan to validate with eng by 2026-03-05)
- On-prem storage: CB has NFS v3 only; we recommended ext4 local disk for model cache. Check ops preference.
- License guardrails for model: CB legal asked about export control for open-llama; Rafael to follow-up.

Testing plan / evals:
- Evals: small prompt set (50 prompts) from CB product team for chat safety/accuracy. Baseline metrics to collect: perplexity run (if applicable), response correctness (binary), latency distribution.
- Load test: 100rps -> 300rps step ramp; watch gpu memory + queueing.

Action items (by owner):
- Rafael: Send VPC/BGP details + VPN contact (due 2026-03-03)
- Maya: Prep VPN strongswan config template + control plane allowlist (due 2026-03-05)
- Priya: Provide Azure KV service principal + sample access policy (due 2026-03-04)
- Jordan: Validate FIPS TLS compatibility with eng (due 2026-03-05)
- Jordan/Maya: Draft canary-run playbook + smoke prompts (due 2026-03-09)

Notes to self (scratch):
- If FIPS incompatible, fallback is to use a Vault HSM shim onsite - longer timeline.
- Consider recommending quantization fallback v1.1 if int8 regression observed (tradeoff: +10% latency for +3% quality).
- Keep synthetic load runner in separate namespace to avoid token accounting mixups.

Related tickets / links:
- JIRA SE-2147: Copper Bay POC - infra prep
- JIRA INC-7812: Initial outage during test (postmortem draft)
- Confluence runbook (link above) - update the deployment commands section with final image tags.
- PR: infra-config #492 - includes control-plane allowlist and vpn template.

Quick timeline (est):
- Week 0: network + KMS creds + install (POC node up)
- Week 1: model load + smoke evals + canary 30m
- Week 2-4: iterate on perf, adjust batching, consider quant profile changes

Scratchpad todo (personal):
- [ ] Push updated runbook to Confluence after canary
- [ ] Add CB eval prompts to repo: /evals/cb
- [ ] Follow up with legal about license export flags

End of scratchpad (saving incremental notes here so I don't lose action items).
